name: Apollo Aggregates warehouse
loot: Two or three weapons on the floor
Sunglasses in the yellow toolbox outside
how: South-east of Hamlet. Follow the highway out of town and look for the gravel operation with the silos — the dead bodies inside tell you you're in the right shed.
risk: Medium: guards, and not all of the haul is instant cash.

name: Manatee Motel (south of Hamlet)
how: The motel just south of Hamlet. Rooms and the office hold the safe; the sniper shows up here. Reported as a dangerous encounter — go armed and go early.
risk: High: guides warn about an animal in the area.

name: Three Sheets Liquor — parrot stash
loot: Cash hidden in an air vent
A parrot clue to the stash
how: In Key Lento. Work the back yard and the vents rather than the front counter — no code needed, guards are the only obstacle.
risk: Low, once the guards are dealt with.

name: Steven Strachan Construction
how: On Sunbelt Hwy in central Key Lento. Go in round the back; the card sits on boxes next to a green box.

name: Palmer Fishing Warehouse
how: On Bobcat Key. The safe is inside the warehouse — punch in 1886 and take the gold AK while you're there.
risk: Very high: flagged as a fight, best attempted after Chapter 1.

name: Stranded boats, Permit Keys
how: Two boats run aground in the Permit Keys. You need a boat or a jet ski to reach them — swim from the nearest key if you have to.
risk: Low, but the approach is the hard part.

name: Wetman Bay fishing shacks
how: The fishing operation on Wetman Bay, out in the wetlands. Armed gang territory, so clear it before you start opening things.

name: Crab research outpost
how: Pelican Valley, in the wetlands. Two codes get mentioned for this one, 0072 and 0212 — try both on the safes, and check the yard, there's a jet ski out there too.

name: Alien bunker east of Cottonmouth Lake
how: Abandoned site east of the Cottonmouth Lake airstrip. Nothing to sell here — this one is for the conspiracy board, not the wallet.

name: Kingpin Bowling safe
loot: Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (from the bowling robbery)
how: The bowling alley in Port Gellhorn. Safe code is 0300; the shotgun comes with the Kolt & Associates robbery that runs through here.

name: Brooks Boatworks
how: Boatworks on the Gellhorn waterfront. The carbine is a free pickup, and there's a code map stashed here worth grabbing before the safes.

name: La Cascara Motel
how: Motel just off the Gellhorn strip. The SMG is in the room, the cash is the point of the visit — one of the better early hauls.

name: The couch in the tree
how: Off Tanglewood Ln., outside a mobile home. A couch is hanging in a tree — the revolver is inside it. Bring it down first, then search. Pure free-roam pickup, no mission or cash needed.

name: Three Port Gellhorn safes
how: Spread across Port Gellhorn rather than one building — the codes reported for the set are 6823, 6969 and 0300. Worth a sweep the moment you reach town.

name: Meteorite site, eastern Mount Kalaga
how: Eastern side of Mount Kalaga National Park, south of Dawson Dam. Backcountry roads only — take something with clearance.
risk: Low, but it's a long walk if you roll something.

name: SOS island and the jet ski dog
how: The little island off Bobcat Key with the dog on a jet ski. Small money, good story, and it is right next to the Palmer warehouse run.

name: Glider in a tree
how: Northern Mariana County. A hang glider is stuck in the treeline with the pistol on it — look up, not down.
